turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Khan from Kolkata?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is she. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mrs. Khan, I am Anirban from the State Bank security department. I am calling to confirm a transaction of eighty thousand rupees made on your account today.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Eighty thousand? I did not do any such thing, oh my god!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please do not worry, the transaction is currently on hold and has not been processed. I am just calling to verify if you initiated this.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: No, no, I have not sent any money. How did this happen?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It looks like a suspicious attempt. Since this is a security alert, I want to remind you that the bank will never ask you for your OTP or PIN over the phone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Is that so? Because someone called me yesterday asking for a code.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That was likely a scammer. Please never share your passwords or Aadhaar details with anyone calling from a mobile number.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank you for telling me. So what should I do now to stop this money from leaving?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You do not need to do anything on this call. Just visit your home branch in Kolkata tomorrow with your ID to formally block the request.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Alright, I will go there tomorrow morning. Thank you for the warning, beta.
